title: MusicDrop v1.5.1 Available
changelog:
• Collapsible Brand Header: Scrolling up seamlessly collapses the MusicDrop brand icon & actions bar, moving the navigation tabs right to the top for maximum screen space
• Quick Reveal: Pulling down or switching tabs immediately reveals the brand logo, search, and settings
• Edge-to-Edge Glass Immersion: Completely borderless header fluidly glowing behind the status bar and camera cutout
• Smooth 60fps Physics: Animated with hardware-accelerated fluid transitions
